label: Estimate (unverified)
method: Hover-survey heights: elevation is 58 m minus the hover reading, and Talon's Public Outpost is the 0 m datum. Positions are trilaterated from in-game Nav distances. North is the bearing from the Outpost to Dragon's Lair, because the game has no compass. This plate is an estimate and is not a survey.

calibration.note: eastZeroSvgX is the plate's 0 m east tick. eastTickSvgX is the 1000 m east tick. North uses the same metres-per-pixel scale. lairNorthM is Dragon's Lair on the plate, due north of the Outpost. Display metres subtract that northing so the Lair stays at the Eden origin.
